cohort: 200 preterm and term infants admitted to neonatal care units in Babylon Maternity and Pediatrics Hospital and Imam Sadik General Teaching Hospital.
finding: Jaundice was the major cause of rehospitalization in both term and preterm neonates.
gest_age: less than 37 weeks for 48.5% of neonates
birth_weight: less than 2500 kg for 45% of neonates
